name: ASHS-PMC-T1ext
shortdesc: Hippocampus and Extended Anterior MTL cortex (ERC, PRC, PHC) segmentation in 3 Tesla T1w MRI
longdesc: Automatic segmentation of anterior/posterior hippocampal and MTL subregions, including entorhinal cortex, perirhinal cortex (BA35 and BA36) and parahippocampal cortex, in T1-weighted 3 Tesla MRI (MPRAGE) scans, using an atlas of older adults with and without mild cognitive impairment from the Penn Memory Center (PMC). This atlas was extended to include more anterior ERC/PRC.

tags.name: T1-MRI
tags.hint: Roughtly isotropic (e.g., 1x1x1mm^3) T1-weighted MRI scan of the whole brain.
